name: cloud-agents-portable-runtime
description: Portable Cloud Agent protocol, provider ABI, runtime, providers, testkit, and pinned distribution

scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run platform:contracts:check && bun run platform:migrations:check && bun run platform:go:check && bun run platform:go:test && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@synara/*' test && vitest run scripts
scripts.platform:go:test: GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go -C services/control-plane test ./... && GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go -C services/control-plane test -race ./... && GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go -C services/control-plane vet ./... && GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go -C services/control-plane mod tidy -diff && GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go -C services/control-plane mod verify
